Each file only works with its own Minecraft version and loader. Install on both client and server.

## What's new

### Shrimp — from fishing to shrimp paste
- **Shrimp** can be fished up (about one in six catches, same category as fish).
- Cut a shrimp with the **kitchen knife** on the **cutting board** to get **peeled shrimp** (a stonecutter works too).
- Pound peeled shrimp **3 times** with the **rolling pin** on the cutting board to make **shrimp paste**.
- Shrimp, peeled shrimp and shrimp paste can all be cooked in the hotpot, furnace, smoker or on a campfire. Raw restores 1 hunger; cooked shrimp 3, cooked peeled shrimp 3, cooked shrimp paste 4.
- Cooked shrimp and cooked peeled shrimp carry a little grey line: "Someone out there really loves shrimp".

### Orient Cola, glass cups
- **Orient Cola**: glass bottle + sugar + cocoa beans + honey bottle. **4 sips** per bottle, each sip gives **Speed and Haste for 15 s**. Fizzy bubbles rise inside the bottle and the cup.
- **Glass Cup**: 5 glass make 4. Right-click an empty cup with a drink to pour one cup in; **one cup = one sip**; the empty cup comes back and can be placed on a table.
- Cups of orange drink, plant protein drink and Orient Cola are their own items, and can be placed on tables like bottles.

### Water and milk in cups
- **Cup of Water** and **Cup of Milk**: right-click an empty cup with a water bucket or milk bucket (in your inventory, or a cup placed on a table) — **the bucket does not empty**. An empty cup can also scoop water from a water source.
- Water does nothing; milk clears all effects (as in vanilla). Neither restores hunger.

### Drinks in cauldrons
- Right-click a **vanilla cauldron** with a drink bottle or a full cup to pour it in (as many sips as are left).
- One cauldron holds **one kind of drink, up to 12 sips** (3 full bottles); the surface rises every 4 sips. The cauldron looks vanilla, with the surface tinted to the drink; **cola fizzes**.
- Scoop with an empty cup (1 sip), a glass bottle or an empty bottle of the same drink (up to 4 sips). Empty it and it turns back into an empty cauldron. Pouring a different drink says "This cauldron holds a different drink".

### Oranges, garlic, tomatoes, cooked kelp
- **Orange**: drops from oak and dark oak leaves, like apples. **Orange drink** = 3 oranges + sugar + glass bottle; **plant protein drink** = 3 soybeans + sugar + glass bottle.
- **Garlic**: drops from grass. Pound 3 times on the cutting board to get 2 **garlic paste** — the **10th seasoning** on the sauce station (Resistance 8 s).
- **Tomato**: drops from grass.
- **Cooked kelp**: cook kelp in the hotpot to get cooked kelp (restores 2). Furnaces and smokers still make vanilla dried kelp.

## What's new

### Yuanyang and four-grid hotpots
- Available in both copper and iron with four divider layouts: **S-Shaped Yuanyang Hotpot, O-Shaped Yuanyang Hotpot, Straight-Divider Yuanyang Hotpot, and Four-Grid Hotpot**.
- Crafting recipe: Combine a nine-grid hotpot with an ingot of the same metal in a crafting table. Ingot placed to the **left** of the pot crafts the S-shaped pot; **below** crafts the O-shaped pot; **above** crafts the straight-divider pot; and **one on each side** crafts the four-grid pot.
- Multi-compartment broths: Each section holds its own broth base, allowing any combination of broths in a single pot. **Pour and scoop broth by aiming at the respective section**; ingredients simmer in the broth of the compartment they sit in.
- The hotpot GUI retains its small-grid layout; cells blocked by dividers are disabled and left empty.
- When picked up, the pot's item icon displays the broth inside each section.
- Double-clicking to collect cooked food only gathers items simmering in the same broth.

### Beef loin and beef loin slices
- Cows and mooshrooms now have a **25%** chance to drop **Beef Loin**.
- **Beef Loin** can be cooked into **Cooked Beef Loin**, restoring as much hunger and saturation as steak.
- Slice it on a **Cutting Board** (with an Iron Kitchen Knife) or in a **Stonecutter** into 3 **Beef Loin Slices**—the fastest food to cook in the pot!

### New chopstick controls
- **Shift + right-click** a pot with **Bamboo Chopsticks** to open the hotpot screen (previously plain right-click).
- **Right-click** a pot with chopsticks to pick up cooked food directly from the targeted slot, then **hold right-click** to eat it.
- Right-clicking a pot while holding raw food still places it into the pot to cook.

### Easier dipping
- When eating with chopsticks, holding **Dipping Sauce** in **either hand** will automatically dip the food (previously off-hand only).
- Right-click a **dipping sauce bowl placed on a table** with food held in your chopsticks to dip it as well.

### Pick up standalone pots
- Standalone pots placed on the ground or on a campfire can now be picked up with **Shift + right-click with an empty hand**, keeping all broth and ingredients inside intact.

- "Creamy Broth" has been renamed to "**Rich Stock**" in every language.
- Translations across 9 languages (English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese) were reviewed and polished; names and hints are now more accurate.

# 0.1.1-alpha · Fabric · Minecraft 1.20.4

> **Alpha warning**: Only preliminary testing has been performed. Compatibility with other mods and potential bugs have not been thoroughly verified. Back up your saves, try the mod in a new world first, and report any issues.
>
> **测试版提醒**：目前仅做过初步测试，与其他模组的兼容性及潜在 bug 尚未充分验证。建议备份存档，优先在新存档中试玩，欢迎反馈问题。

## English

This is the **Fabric port for Minecraft 1.20.4** of the published **0.1.1-alpha**. It carries over the stoves, iron/copper nine-grid hotpots, four broths, chopsticks, tables, seats, plates, tripe, bowls and drinks from that release. Drinks remain Creative-only. Later dipping-sauce and food-preparation features are outside this release.

- Minecraft **1.20.4 only**; **Fabric Loader 0.15.11+** (tested dependency: 0.19.3).
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for **1.20.4** (tested dependency: **0.97.3+1.20.4**).
- **Java 17+**. Install on **both client and server**.
- Pot steam uses the same white-smoke particle type as 1.21.1.
- Preliminary tests cover build/startup and selected command-driven checks. In-game interactions, rendering and compatibility need further testing.

Ports for Minecraft **1.20.1 Forge** and **1.21.1 NeoForge** are in progress and expected to be released soon.

## 中文

这是已发布 **0.1.1-alpha** 的 **Minecraft 1.20.4 Fabric 移植版**，延续该版的灶台、铁锅 / 铜锅、四种汤底、筷子、桌凳、盘子、毛肚、碗与饮料。饮料仍暂时只能通过创造模式获取，后续开发中的蘸料、切菜等内容不属于本版。

- 仅支持 Minecraft **1.20.4**；**Fabric Loader 0.15.11+**（测试时使用 0.19.3）。
- 安装 **1.20.4 对应的 Fabric API**（测试时使用 **0.97.3+1.20.4**）。
- 使用 **Java 17 或更新版本**，**客户端和服务端均需安装**。
- 1.20.4 的锅中热气使用与 1.21.1 相同的白烟粒子。
- 目前只完成初步构建、启动及部分命令检查，游戏内交互、渲染与兼容性仍需进一步测试。

Minecraft **1.20.1 Forge** 和 **1.21.1 NeoForge** 正在移植中，预计很快发布。
